# Binding markup reference

Generic Bind overloads and binding path builders.

### BindingPath&lt;TRoot, TOwner&gt;

Receiver: `BindingPath<TRoot, TOwner>`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Then(MewProperty<TNext> property)` |  | Appends an observable MewProperty segment. |
| `ThenIndexed(Func<TOwner, TNext> getter, string getterExpression = null)` |  | Appends a read-only segment that reads an indexer and observes the owner's collection change or indexer change notifications. |
| `ThenNotifying(Func<TOwner, TNext> getter, Action<TOwner, TNext> setter = null, string getterExpression = null)` |  | Appends a segment that reads getter and observes the owner's PropertyChanged for the property that getter names. |

### MewObject

Receiver: `MewObject` and derived types (`where T : MewObject`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Bind(MewProperty<T> property, MewObject source, MewProperty<T> sourceProperty)` |  | Binds a MewProperty to another MewObject's MewProperty and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<T> property, ObservableValue<T> source, BindingMode? mode = null)` |  | Binds a MewProperty to an ObservableValue and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<T> property, TRoot source, BindingPath<TRoot, T> path, BindingMode? mode = null, T fallbackValue = null)` |  | Binds a property to a reusable delegate-based path and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<T> property, TSource source, Func<TSource, ObservableValue<T>> selector, BindingMode? mode = null)` |  | Binds a property to an ObservableValue reached through source and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<T> property, TSource source, Func<TSource, T> getter, Action<TSource, T> setter = null, BindingMode? mode = null, string getterExpression = null)` |  | Binds a property to a single notifying property of source and returns the element for chaining; omitting setter makes the binding OneWay. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<TProp> property, MewObject source, MewProperty<TSource> sourceProperty, Func<TSource, TProp> convert, Func<TProp, TSource> convertBack = null, BindingMode? mode = null)` |  | Binds a MewProperty to another MewObject's converted MewProperty and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<TProp> property, ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, TProp> convert, Func<TProp, TSource> convertBack = null, BindingMode? mode = null)` |  | Binds a MewProperty to a converted ObservableValue and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<TProp> property, TRoot source, BindingPath<TRoot, TSource> path, Func<TSource, TProp> convert, Func<TProp, TSource> convertBack = null, BindingMode? mode = null, TProp fallbackValue = null)` |  | Binds a property to a converted reusable delegate-based path and returns the element for chaining. |
| `Bind(MewProperty<TProp> property, TSource source, Func<TSource, TValue> getter, Func<TValue, TProp> convert, Action<TSource, TValue> setter = null, Func<TProp, TValue> convertBack = null, BindingMode? mode = null, string getterExpression = null)` |  | Binds a property to a converted single notifying property of source and returns the element for chaining. |
